faqs.question: What is nologin.tools?
faqs.answer: nologin.tools is a curated, verified directory of privacy-respecting online tools and utilities that work instantly without requiring user registration, accounts, or personal data collection.

faqs.question: How are tools verified on nologin.tools?
faqs.answer: Every tool is empirically vetted in the NoLogin Lab using the CADES 2.0 evaluation framework. We verify client-side data handling, zero-egress network behavior, and account-free functionality before approval.

faqs.question: Are the tools on nologin.tools free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, every tool listed in the directory can be used for its core tasks without payment, credit card information, or account creation.

faqs.question: How can I embed a verification badge on my site?
faqs.answer: Verified tools can embed live status badges by visiting their tool detail page or badge page at https://nologin.tools/badge/ and copying the SVG embed snippet.

faqs.question: What are the best free no-login alternatives to Photoshop, Canva, Miro, and Google Docs?
faqs.answer: Top verified no-login web workstations include: Photopea (for Adobe Photoshop PSD raster editing), Squoosh (for TinyPNG WebAssembly compression), Excalidraw (for Miro virtual whiteboarding with E2EE), Diagrams.net / draw.io (for Lucidchart and Visio architecture diagrams), and CryptPad / Dillinger (for Google Docs private markdown editing). All run in-browser without account creation.

faqs.question: Can I process confidential PDFs, images, and audio without uploading files to remote servers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tools tagged as 'Client-Side Only' on nologin.tools (such as BytePriva, Squoosh, AudioMass, and hat.sh) process 100% of data locally in browser memory via WebAssembly and Web Crypto APIs with zero network egress bytes.

faqs.question: How does NoLogin Lab calculate the 5D Product Power Score?
faqs.answer: NoLogin Lab evaluates tools across 5 empirical dimensions (100-point scale): Frictionless UX (20), Functional Depth & Fidelity (25), Export Freedom (20), Privacy & Zero-Egress Sovereignty (20), and Stability & Polish (15). Tools scoring 90+ receive the Editor's Choice designation.
